description: Start a job to transform an owned image's subject. First call chargen_quote_image_change_subject, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job. Only the declared settings are supported. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

image_id.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery. Creates a new image.

instruction.description: Describe only the change to make, and what to keep the same.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_image_change_subject. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

name: chargen_edit_image_change_subject
title: Start change subject
